name: King Vian

facts.text: King Vian: level 43, an ursine body (model 393, the ursine patrols' and warriors'), at about 31,640/35,570 in the southern hall among ursine dwellers (36), warriors (37-40), a patrol and a sorcerer (39); the Lair Overseer is about 1,500 away; no faction; respawn 180 seconds; a plain spawn.
Living Server lore: King Vian's line won the tribe's old quarrel and the forge's keeper never bowed to it.

story:
Vian is the king of the ursine of Treibh Caillte, and the realm knows him chiefly from people who saw him and came back puzzled. He is not a cruel-looking king. He sits in the southern hall among the old and young of his tribe, the ursine dwellers, with his warriors at the turns of the passage and a sorcerer reading the stone for him, and he listens more than he speaks, which in a bear is unsettling.

The druids say his line won the old quarrel that split the tribe, and put the losers in collars, and that a king who rules a hall worked by thralls is a king of a tribe that has already broken. The firbolg of Lough Derg say the druids have the wrong losers. Either way the collars are Vian's, and the Lair Overseer counts them at his door.

There is one thing in the caves a king cannot command. Below Hervelina's ledge the Dreaded Ursine keeps the first smiths' forge, and it was keeping it before Vian's grandfather took the hall, and it has never bowed to any of his line. Vian has never gone down to it. Hervelina says that a king who cannot reach his own tribe's fire is only a chieftain with a better chair, and that Vian knows it, and that this is why he listens: he is waiting to hear that the fire has gone out, so that he can light it again himself.
legend: King Vian (43) holds the southern hall of Treibh Caillte (about 31.6k/35.6k) with ursine dwellers (36), warriors (37-40), a patrol and a sorcerer (39) round him; take the hall apart from the edges. The Lair Overseer (39) and his thralls are about 1,500 away; Thorg (42) is in the passages west. A group of mid 40s. Not part of Immortal Gift. Plain spawn, no script, 3-minute respawn.

aggro: You walk in my hall unasked.
slay: Collar that one. If it breathes.
